'''Vahla''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by members of the [[near-Human]] [[Vahla]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vahla was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LECG" />
